messages:
sophie: Quick summary request Onboarded 'novus-9b' fp16 yesterday. ran int4-lite (w/ per-layer calibration). Need a short PD-ready blurb: unit econ, perf delta, and routing suggestion.

ben: high level: int4 lowers unit cost a lot (~55%) but some small quality regressions on multi-turn state and role-consistency. throughput +70% on our T4-like fleet.

irene: paste numbers (dedicated gpus emu): ```
fp16: 800 tok/s, med latency 160ms, p99 520ms
int4-lite: 1360 tok/s (+70%), med latency 95ms, p99 340ms
unit cost est: fp16 $0.0020/token -> int4 $0.0009/token (~-55%)
quality deltas: single-turn instr 0.0-0.2%, multi-turn persona consistency -1.4%, code-gen BLEU -0.9
```

sophie: callouts: regressions concentrated in prolonged persona-based chat and long code snippets. short completions and embeddings-equivalent tasks look fine.

maya: product asks: acceptable thresholds? last playbook uses 1% utility loss for core flows, 2% for low-stakes. with int4 we're at ~1.4 in worst slices.

ben: routing rec: use int4 for bulk low-stakes traffic; keep fp16 for sessions flagged by detector (persona_flag, long_code, session_turns>7). also try a hybrid: start session on int4, promote to fp16 when detector fires.

irene: quick econ sim: for 120M tokens/month, shifting 85% to int4 -> gross savings ~$111k/mo. realistic constrained adoption (50% after detectors) -> ~$65k/mo.

ops-bot: staging soak int4: 1h, no OOMs, p99 tail stable, minor tokenization mismatch alerts (0.5%).

sophie: proposed two-line PD blurb: "Recommend adopting int4-lite for bulk non-persona/code flows to reduce unit cost ~50-60% and improve latency; keep fp16 or dynamic promote for persona-heavy or long-code sessions with a 1% utility-drop guardrail. Start 5% canary with detector and nightly evals."

maya: please add a small scorecard and flagset we can paste into GTN doc.

irene: scorecard snippet: ```
Scorecard (int4-lite vs fp16)
- Unit cost delta: -55%
- Median latency: 95ms vs 160ms
- p99: 340ms vs 520ms
- Persona continuity: -1.4% (sessions>7)
- Code BLEU: -0.9
Operational recs:
- Canary 5% -> 25% -> 60% with nightly eval checks
- Detector rules: persona_flag, code_block_>200tokens, session_turns_>7
- Auto-fallback on sustained utility drop >=1% for 12h
```

ben: routing flagset (paste-ready): `{
  "strategy":"dynamic_promote",
  "canary_pct":5,
  "ramp_steps":[25,60],
  "promote_triggers":["persona_flag","code_block_>200","session_turns_>7"],
  "utility_threshold_pct":1.0
}`

maya: great. i'll ship this to GTN with the blurb + scorecard. thanks team :rocket:
